title: A pictorial introduction to differential geometry (2017)
summary: An arXiv paper providing a visual, intuitive approach to learning differential geometry through diagrams and pictures, targeting newcomers to the field who may find traditional textbook presentations abstract or challenging.
problem_solved: Makes the abstract and mathematically rigorous field of differential geometry more accessible through visual intuition.
why_valuable: Differential geometry is foundational for general relativity, computer graphics, and machine learning, yet traditionally taught with heavy formalism—visual approaches can significantly lower the learning barrier.
